item.title: Correction · Channel Street (open space): The record's notes and its earlier change entry said the…
item.description: The record's notes and its earlier change entry said the 2019 Phase 1 submittal delivered an interim plaza here, that the permanent design comes with Block C, and that satellite imagery shows paving and planting today. The 2019 submittal is only a plan and does not say which lot any interim plaza is; nothing read ties Channel Street to Block C; and no imagery source was cited. Those claims are removed and the notes say the lot's current condition is not confirmed; status stays planned. The June 2026 Phase 2 milestone that named Channel Street and Block C was removed from this record because the Port memo never mentions either. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone no longer calls the space an interim plaza and now cites the Sep 2019 Port memo that states the date. Source: Mission Rock Partners, Mission Rock Phase 1 Overview, 2019-07-02 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2011D%20Attachment%201%20Mission%20Rock%20Draft%20Phase%201%20Submittal%20Summary_06%2027%2019_2.pdf) (does not state this); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf) (does not state this); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf).

item.title: Added · Channel Street (open space): Channel Street added on its real lot: the planned open space…
item.description: Channel Street added on its real lot: the planned open space between Blocks B and C. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned interim treatments for Channel Street; what was built on the lot is not confirmed. (An earlier version of this entry said it was an interim plaza today, which no source supports.) Source: Mission Rock Design Controls, Section 3.7; 2019 Phase 1 submittal; DataSF Parcels; Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sep 20 2019 (January 30, 2018 approval).

item.title: Planned · Channel Street (open space): Port Commission approves the Mission Rock… (Jan 30, 2018)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls (Resolution No. 18-04) and, in the same Jan 30, 2018 vote, the Disposition and Development Agreement (Resolution No. 18-03; Port minutes, Item 11.A, pp.4-5 and 19). The Design Controls define the planned Channel Street open space (Design Controls Section 3.7, April 24, 2018 final version; the earlier version the Commission approved was not read); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sep 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05) (Jan 30, 2018). Source: Port Commission Item 11A staff report, Jan 26 2018 (request), https://sfport.com/media/3259/download; Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sep 20 2019 (approval date), https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf; Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24 2018 final version (section), https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf; Port Commission minutes, Jan 30, 2018 (Item 11.A, Resolution Nos. 18-03 to 18-10 adopted), https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download.
